candidates.title: MRD negativity by PBMCs and ctDNA confirms deep and durable responses after epcoritamab monotherapy in R/R FL.
candidates.abstract: In EPCORE NHL-1, the CD3 × CD20 bispecific antibody epcoritamab demonstrated promising efficacy and manageable safety in patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) follicular lymphoma (FL) after ≥2 prior lines of therapy. Using the clonoSEQ assay, we evaluated minimal residual disease (MRD) status using peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) and/or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) at prespecified time points and investigated their correlation with clinical outcomes. Epcoritamab induced rapid conversion to MRD negativity, with most MRD-evaluable patients reaching MRD negativity by cycle 3 (C3) day 1 (D1) as measured by either analyte. MRD negativity at C3D1 landmark by either analyte correlated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS; median not reached), irrespective of radiographic response status. PFS was comparable among patients with overall MRD negativity by PBMCs or ctDNA, regardless of challenging-to-treat disease features. By C3D1 and C5D1 landmarks, patients with complete or partial response, as assessed by positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT), who were MRD positive had a shorter PFS compared with those who were MRD negative. In multivariable analyses at week 12 and week 18 PET/CT landmarks, MRD-negative responders by PBMC assessment (week 12) and by both PBMC and ctDNA assessment (week 18) had significantly improved PFS when adjusted for baseline clinical risk factors. These analyses demonstrate that MRD negativity is associated with rapid molecular responses to epcoritamab and prolonged PFS in patients with R/R FL, underscoring the value of MRD analysis to complement conventional response assessment. These findings may aid future clinical trial design or clinical practice in FL. This trial was registered at www.clinicaltrials.gov as NCT03625037.

candidates.abstract_ja: EPCORE NHL-1では、CD3 × CD20二重特異的抗体エコリタマブは、≥2回の既往治療ライン後、再発/難治性(R/R)濾胞リンパ腫(FL)患者において有望な有効性と管理可能な安全性を示しました。clonoSEQアッセイを用いて、予め指定された時点で末梢血単核球(PBMC)および/または循環腫瘍DNA(ctDNA)を用いて最小残存病変(MRD)の状態を評価し、臨床転帰との相関を調べました。エプコリタマブはMRD陰性への迅速な転換を誘導し、ほとんどのMRD評価患者はいずれの分析対象でも3周期(C3)1日目(D1)までにMRD陰性に達しました。いずれの分析対象によるC3D1ランドマークにおけるMRD陰性も、放射線学的反応の有無にかかわらず、無進行生存期間(PFS;中央値未到達)と相関していました。PFSは、治療が困難な疾患特徴にかかわらず、PBMCまたはctDNAによる全体MRD陰性を持つ患者でも比較可能です。C3D1およびC5D1のランドマークでは、陽電子放出断層撮影/コンピュータ断層撮影(PET/CT)で完全または部分的反応が認められ、MRD陽性の患者はMRD陰性患者に比べてPFSが短かった。12週および18週のPET/CTランドマークにおける多変数解析では、PBMC評価(12週目)およびPBMCおよびctDNA評価(18週目)によるMRD陰性反応者は、ベースラインの臨床リスク因子を調整したことでPFSが有意に改善した。これらの解析は、MRD陰性がR/R FL患者におけるエコリタマブへの迅速な分子反応およびPFSの長期化と関連していることを示し、従来の反応評価を補完するMRD解析の価値を強調しています。これらの発見は、将来のFLにおける臨床試験設計や臨床実践に役立つ可能性があります。本試験は www.clinicaltrials.gov 年に登録NCT03625037。

candidates.title: Myofibroblast Derived Transglutaminase 2 Activity is Upregulated in Stricturing Crohn's Disease and its Inhibition Exerts Anti-Fibrotic Properties.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix (ECM) derived from human intestinal myofibroblasts (HIMF) drives the significant clinical problem of intestinal fibrosis. Fibrosis is believed to progress even in the absence of intestinal inflammation. ECM-bound transglutaminase 2 (TG2) enzyme may exert direct pro-fibrotic effects. We investigated the role of TG2 in intestinal fibrosis. METHODS: TG2 expression and activity in human intestinal tissue and HIMF from strictured Crohn's disease (CDs), and controls were measured. ECM accumulation by HIMF in presence or absence of TG2 inhibitors was determined. Putative TG2 signaling pathways discovered in HIMF using bulk RNA sequencing (bulk-RNAseq) and single cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) were functionally validated. Role of TG2 in vivo was confirmed using inducible global knockout of TGM2 (encoding TG2) in two experimental fibrosis models. RESULTS: TG activity was increased in CDs compared to controls, with up to 100% activity attributable to TG2. TG activity correlated with the degree of histopathologic tissue fibrosis. HIMF were the major source of TG2, with ≥95% of HIMF TG activity being derived from TG2. Tissue distribution of TG2 in myofibroblasts was confirmed by scRNAseq analysis. Selective inhibition of TG2 activity reduced fibronectin (FN), collagen (COL)I, III and VI accumulation by HIMF. Novel TG2 signaling pathways revealed by bulk-RNAseq, were functionally validated. Inducible TGM2 knockout prevented experimental fibrosis without affecting the degree of intestinal inflammation. CONCLUSIONS: TG2 may be involved in inflammation-independent progression of intestinal fibrosis.
candidates.title_ja: ミオフィブロブラスト由来のトランスグルタミナーゼ2活性は、閉鎖性クローン病において上位調節され、その抑制作用は抗線維化作用を発揮します。
candidates.abstract_ja: 背景および目的:ヒト腸内筋線維芽細胞(HIMF)由来の細胞外マトリックス(ECM)の過剰蓄積が、腸線維症という重大な臨床問題を引き起こします。線維化は腸内炎症がなくても進行すると考えられています。ECM結合型トランスグルタミナーゼ2(TG2)酵素は直接的な線維化促進効果を発揮する可能性があります。我々は腸線維症におけるTG2の役割を調査しました。方法:閉塞性クローン病(CD)および対照群におけるヒト腸組織におけるTG2の発現および活性を測定しました。TG2阻害剤の有無にかかわらずHIMFによるECM蓄積が判明しました。HIMFで発見された推定のTG2シグナル伝達経路は、バルクRNAシーケンシング(bulk-RNAseq)および単細胞RNAシーケンシング(scRNAseq)を用いて機能的に検証されました。TG2の役割は、2つの実験的線維症モデルで誘導可能な全域ノックアウト(TGM2をコード)を用いて確認されました。結果:CDではTG活性が対照群と比較して増加し、最大100%の活性がTG2に起因しました。TG活性は組織病理学的組織線維症の程度と相関していました。HIMFはTG2の主な供給源であり、HIMFのTG活性の≥95%はTG2由来です。筋線維芽細胞におけるTG2の組織分布はscRNAseq解析によって確認されました。TG2活性の選択的阻害により、HIMFによるフィブロネクチン(FN)、コラーゲン(COL)I、III、VIの蓄積が減少しました。バルクRNAセクイシスによって明らかになった新規TG2シグナル伝達経路が機能的に検証されました。誘導性TGM2ノックアウトは、腸の炎症の程度に影響を与えることなく実験的な線維化を防げました。結論:TG2は腸線維症の炎症に依存しない進行に関与している可能性があります。

candidates.title: Surface charge alterations in urinary extracellular vesicles mirror diabetic kidney disease pathophysiology.
candidates.abstract: Urinary extracellular vesicles (uEVs) are an attractive source of biomarkers as their cargo of proteins, nucleic acids and lipids reflects cell pathophysiology. The physical properties of uEVs such as their electrical nature measured by the zeta potential (charge at the interface of vesicle and liquid) are seldom explored although their understanding may lead to translational applications of EVs in clinical settings. In diabetes and diabetic kidney disease (DKD), post-translational modifications resulting from loss of glycocalyx (diabetes) and gain of extracellular matrix components (tissue fibrosis) could potentially affect the electrical charge of pathologically relevant EVs. DKD cohorts obtained by adhering to industry-standard reproducible criteria were stratified into stable and progressive disease based on estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) loss and compared to nonkidney disease diabetic and healthy controls. Surface charge analysis revealed a significant difference in the zeta potential of large uEVs between the diabetic and healthy cohorts, as well as between the diabetic and DKD-progressive cohorts. These differences are mechanistically consistent with pathological alterations observed in heparan sulfate (HS) content. Accordingly, uEVs from DKD patients exhibited higher HS levels than those from diabetic individuals, as assessed by SP-IRIS/ExoView using HS-binding capture. Comparative proteomic analysis further demonstrated an increased abundance of the sulfated glycosaminoglycan lumican in DKD uEVs relative to diabetes, consistent with its reported upregulation in early fibrotic stages of DKD. Notably, our findings indicate for the first time that the zeta potential of large uEVs may be predictive of the progression of diabetes into DKD.
candidates.title_ja: 尿の細胞外小胞における表面電荷の変化は、糖尿病腎病の病態生理を反映しています。
candidates.abstract_ja: 尿外細胞外小胞(uEV)は、タンパク質、核酸、脂質の貨物が細胞の病態生理を反映するため、バイオマーカーの魅力的な供給源です。小胞と液体の界面における電荷(ゼータ電位)で測定されるuEVの電気的性質などの物理的特性はほとんど研究されていませんが、その理解は臨床現場でのEVの翻訳応用につながる可能性があります。糖尿病および糖尿病腎疾患(DKD)では、グリコカリックス(糖尿病)の喪失や細胞外マトリックス成分の増加(組織線維症)による翻訳後修飾が、病理学的に関連したEVの電荷に影響を与える可能性があります。業界標準の再現性基準に従って得られたDKDコホートは、推定された糸球体濾過率(eGFR)の損失に基づき安定病と進行性病に階層化され、非腎臓病の糖尿病患者および健康な対照群と比較して評価されました。表面電荷解析では、糖尿病患者と健康なコホート間、ならびに糖尿病患者とDKD進行性コホート間で大きなuEVのゼータ電位に有意な差が見られました。これらの違いは、ヘパラン硫酸(HS)含有量の病理学的変化と機構的に整合しています。したがって、SP-IRIS/ExoViewによるHS結合キャプチャを用いて評価したところ、DKD患者のuEVは糖尿病患者よりも高いHSレベルを示しました。比較プロテオミクス解析では、DKD uEVにおける硫酸化グリコサミノグリカンルミカンの存在量が糖尿病に比べて増加していることが示されており、これはDKDの初期線維化期における報告されたアップレギュレーションと一致しています。特筆すべきは、本研究結果が初めて、大きなuEVのゼータ電位が糖尿病のDKDへの進行を予測する可能性があることを示していることです。

candidates.title: Humoral Immunogenicity of mRNA-1010, an mRNA-based Seasonal Influenza Vaccine, in Adults ≥50 Years.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: Seasonal influenza causes substantial morbidity and mortality worldwide. In a phase 3 study in adults ≥50 years, trivalent mRNA-1010 demonstrated superior efficacy vs a standard-dose (SD) seasonal influenza vaccine. This analysis reports humoral immunogenicity. METHODS: Participants were randomized 1:1 to a single dose of mRNA-1010 (37.5-µg) or licensed SD influenza vaccine. Immunogenicity was assessed in a prespecified per-protocol subset. Antihemagglutinin antibody titers were measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and microneutralization (MN; subset) at baseline and day 29 against vaccine-matched strains. Outcomes included geometric mean titers (GMTs), geometric mean fold rises (GMFRs) from baseline, and seroconversion rates (SCRs; ≥4-fold rise). RESULTS: The Per-Protocol Immunogenicity Subset included 2342 participants (mRNA-1010, n = 1167; SD influenza vaccine, n = 1175). mRNA-1010 induced higher levels of HAI antibodies relative to SD influenza vaccine. mRNA-1010 increased HAI GMTs, with day 29 GMFRs of 4.07 (A/H1N1), 4.70 (A/H3N2), and 3.14 (B/Victoria). Geometric mean ratio point estimates vs SD influenza vaccine exceeded 1.5 across all strains, with lower bounds (LBs) of 95% CIs all exceeding 1.4: 1.82 (95% confidence interval [CI], 1.69-1.97), 1.59 (1.48-1.71), and 1.67 (1.57-1.78), respectively. Similarly, SCR differences were positive; LBs >15: 27.95% (95% CI: 24.09-31.73), 19.99% (15.99-23.92), and 25.33% (21.65-28.95), respectively. mRNA-1010 elicited higher MN antibody responses vs SD influenza vaccine for all 3 strains. CONCLUSIONS: In adults ≥50 years, a single dose of mRNA-1010 induced higher humoral immune responses against vaccine-matched influenza strains than licensed SD influenza vaccine. Together with previously reported results, these findings support mRNA-1010 as a seasonal influenza vaccine option in adults ≥50 years. CLINICAL TRIALS REGISTRATION: NCT06602024.
candidates.title_ja: 成人≥50歳におけるmRNAベースの季節性インフルエンザワクチンmRNA-1010の体液性免疫原性。
candidates.abstract_ja: 背景:季節性インフルエンザは世界的に著しい罹患率と死亡率を引き起こします。成人≥50年を対象とした第3相試験では、三価mRNA-1010が標準用量(SD)季節性インフルエンザワクチンよりも優れた有効性を示しました。本解析は体液性免疫原性を報告しています。方法:参加者はmRNA-1010(37.5-μg)または認可されたSDインフルエンザワクチンの単回投与に1:1で無作為に割り当てられました。免疫原性はあらかじめ指定されたプロトコルのサブセットで評価されました。抗ヘマグルチニン抗体価は、ワクチン適合株に対してベースラインおよび29日目にヘマグルチーニン阻害(HAI)および微量中和(MN; サブセット)によって測定されました。アウトカムには幾何平均抗体価(GMT)、基準からの幾何平均フォールド増加(GMFR)、および血清変換率(SCRs;≥4倍増加)が含まれていました。結果:プロトコルごとの免疫原性サブセットには2342名の参加者が含まれていました(mRNA-1010、n = 1167;SDインフルエンザワクチン、n = 1175)。mRNA-1010はSDインフルエンザワクチンに比べてHAI抗体のレベルが高いを誘導しました。mRNA-1010はHAI GMTを増加させ、29日目のGMFRは4.07(A/H1N1)、4.70(A/H3N2)、3.14(B/Victoria)でした。幾何平均比比ポイント推定値は、すべての株で1.5を超え、95%信頼区間の下限(LB)はすべて1.4を超えました(95%信頼区間[CI]1.69-1.97)、1.59(1.48-1.71)、1.67(1.57-1.78)。同様に、SCRの差異は陽性でした。LBs>15:27.95%(95%信頼区間:24.09-31.73)、19.99%(15.99-23.92)、25.33%(21.65-28.95)をそれぞれ超えました。mRNA-1010は3株すべてでSDインフルエンザワクチンに比べてより高いMN抗体応答を誘発しました。結論:成人≥50歳において、mRNA-1010の単回投与は、認可されたSDインフルエンザワクチンよりもワクチン適合型インフルエンザ株に対する体液性免疫応答を高く誘導した。これまでに報告された結果と合わせて、これらの結果は成人≥50歳における季節性インフルエンザワクチンの選択肢としてのmRNA-1010を支持している。臨床試験登録:NCT06602024。

candidates.title: Helmet-Mounted display cues enhance visual acquisition of mid-air collision hazards beyond using head-up displays alone.
candidates.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study undertook an experimental comparison of visual acquisition for the avoidance of Mid-Air Collisions (MAC) when using cueing provided by Head-Up Display (HUD) and Helmet-Mounted Display (HMD) symbology. BACKGROUND: Previous work has shown that providing accurate cueing can improve visual detection performance, but no study had quantified the impact of providing cues via a HMD to reduce MAC risk. METHOD: Military fast jet pilots flew two scenarios in a Virtual Reality (VR) simulation. In one, a HUD provided cues to nearby aircraft. In the other, a HMD was used alongside the HUD to provide cues. The study measured visual acquisition range of aircraft that posed a MAC risk, as well as subjective workload, Situation Awareness (SA), gaze direction, and qualitative feedback. RESULTS: Visual acquisition occurred at a longer range when HMD cues were available compared to using a HUD only. HMD cueing was associated with lower subjective workload and higher perceived SA. Participant gaze direction indicated that HMD cues resulted in a more focused visual search. CONCLUSION: Including HMD alongside the existing HUD used in military aircraft improved visual acquisition of MAC hazards, beyond that offered by HUD alone. The clear presentation of spatially referenced cues in the HMD enabled pilots to use a focused visual search process, improved SA and reduced workload.
candidates.title_ja: ヘルメットに取り付けたディスプレイキューは、ヘッドアップディスプレイだけではない空中衝突の危険を視覚的に捉えやすくします。
candidates.abstract_ja: 目的:本研究は、ヘッドアップディスプレイ(HUD)およびヘルメット搭載ディスプレイ(HMD)による手がかりを用いた際、空中衝突(MAC)回避のための視覚獲得を実験的に比較しました。背景:過去の研究では、正確な手がかりを提供することで視覚的検出性能が向上することが示されていますが、HMDによる手がかりの提供がMACリスクを低減する効果を定量化した研究はありませんでした。方法:軍用高速ジェットパイロットは、バーチャルリアリティ(VR)シミュレーションで2つのシナリオを飛行しました。1つはHUDが近くの航空機に手がかりを提供しました。もう1つはHUDと並行して手がかりを提供しました。この研究では、MACリスクとなる航空機の視覚的取得範囲、主観的な負荷、状況認識(SA)、視線方向、質的フィードバックを測定しました。結果:HMD手がかりが利用可能な場合、HUDのみを使うよりも視覚的取得がより長距離で行われました。HMDの手がかりは主観的な負荷が低く、感知されるSAが高いと関連していました。参加者の視線の方向は、HMDの手がかりにより焦点を絞った視覚的探索をもたらしたことを示しました。結論:軍用航空機で既に使用されているHUDとHMDを併用することで、HUD単独以上のMACハザードの視覚的獲得が向上しました。HMDにおける空間参照手がかりの明確な提示により、パイロットは焦点を絞った視覚的探索プロセスを用いることができ、SAが向上し、作業負荷が軽減されました。

candidates.title: Differential impacts of Colorado River shortage operations on agricultural adaptation and groundwater reliance in Central Arizona
candidates.abstract: Severe Colorado River reservoir declines triggered mandatory Tier 1 delivery reductions since 2022. The resulting agricultural adaptations and groundwater impacts remain poorly quantified as the reductions fall disproportionately among water users with different delivery priorities. We compared two adjacent irrigation districts in central Arizona with contrasting Central Arizona Project (CAP) delivery priorities: the Maricopa-Stanfield Irrigation and Drainage District (MSIDD; low priority) and the Ak-Chin Indian Community (Ak-Chin; senior tribal entitlement). We integrated CubeSat imagery, Random Forest classifications, and OpenET evapotranspiration ( ET ) products within a water accounting framework to quantify changes in cultivated area, crop composition, consumptive water use, and groundwater reliance. Calibrated with historical records, the framework reproduced annual irrigation totals with normalized mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.0% at Ak-Chin and 4.7% at MSIDD. During the shortage period (2022–2024), Ak-Chin maintained > 99% cultivated area and a stable crop portfolio. In contrast, the 98% reduction in CAP deliveries to MSIDD prompted substantial agricultural adjustments, including a 25.9% contraction in cultivated area and a shift from high- to lower-water-use crops, with alfalfa area decreasing by 38.6% and barley area increasing by 112.7%. Ensemble ET decreased by 61.1 hm³ yr⁻¹ (27.4%), with fallowing and crop switching explaining 72% and 24% of the decline, respectively. The 147.5 hm³ yr⁻¹ loss of CAP deliveries was balanced by lower irrigation volumes (73%) and additional groundwater pumping (27%). These results illustrate the role of delivery priority on fallowing, crop substitution, and groundwater use, and demonstrate a transferable framework for monitoring of agricultural adaptation and water use.
candidates.title_ja: コロラド川の水不足運用が中央アリゾナ州の農業適応および地下水依存に及ぼす異なる影響
candidates.abstract_ja: コロラド川の貯水量の深刻な減少により、2022年以降、義務的なティア1の供給削減が引き起こされている。削減措置は水配分優先度の異なる水利権者の間で不均等に適用されるため、その結果生じる農業の適応と地下水への影響については、十分に定量化されていない。我々は、中央アリゾナ・プロジェクト（CAP）の配分優先度が対照的な中央アリゾナの隣接する2つの灌漑地区、すなわちマリコパ・スタンフィールド灌漑排水地区（MSIDD；低優先度）とアック・チン・インディアン・コミュニティ（アック・チン；上位の先住民族水利権）を比較した。水会計フレームワーク内にCubeSat画像、ランダムフォレスト分類、OpenET蒸発散（ET）プロダクトを統合し、耕地面積、作物構成、消費的水利用、および地下水依存の変化を定量化した。過去の記録で較正されたこのフレームワークにより、アック・チンでの正規化平均絶対誤差（MAE）2.0%、MSIDDでの4.7%という精度で年間灌漑総量を再現した。水不足期間（2022〜2024年）中、アック・チンは99%超の耕地面積と安定した作物ポートフォリオを維持した。対照的に、MSIDDへのCAP供給の98%削減は、耕地面積の25.9%の縮小や、高水消費作物から低水消費作物への移行（アルファルファ面積が38.6%減少し大麦面積が112.7%増加するなど）といった大幅な農業的調整を促した。アンサンブルETは年間61.1 hm³減少し（27.4%減）、休耕と作物の切り替えが減少のそれぞれ72%と24%を説明した。CAP供給の年間147.5 hm³の損失は、灌漑水量の減少（73%）と追加の地下水汲み上げ（27%）によって相殺された。これらの結果は、休耕、作物置換、および地下水利用に対する配分優先度の役割を示し、農業適応と水利用をモニタリングするための移転可能なフレームワークを実証するものである。

candidates.title: Differentiation of axial spondyloarthritis-related lesions from degenerative lesions on Na[18F]Fluoride PET/CT in a longitudinal dataset of patients with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis.
candidates.abstract: PURPOSE: To investigate longitudinal changes of Na[18F]Fluoride uptake in the axial skeleton of patients with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (r-axSpA) during biological treatment, focusing on r-axSpA and degenerative (D) lesions. METHODS: 20 active r-axSpA patients were included. Na[18F]Fluoride Positron Emission Tomography / Computed Tomography (PET/CT) scans were performed prior to, as well as 12 and 52 weeks after starting biological therapy. PET-positive lesions in the axial skeleton were scored and classified by two blinded readers. Quantitative Na[18F]Fluoride uptake was assessed by determination of standardized uptake values (SUV) corrected for individual integrated whole blood activity concentration (SUVAUC). RESULTS: A total of 276 lesions with visual Na[18F]Fluoride uptake were detected, of which 98 (36%) were defined as r-axSpA and 46 (17%) as D. The total number of r-axSpA lesions decreased from 98 at baseline to 67 at week 12 (-32%) and to 55 at week 52 (-18%), while the number of D lesions remained stable over time. The majority of r-axSpA lesions were observed in the thoracic spine (84%), while the majority of D lesions were observed in the lumbar spine (48%). Quantitatively, 84% and 88% of the r-axSpA lesions showed a decrease of Na[18F]Fluoride uptake between baseline and 12 and 52 weeks, respectively. In contrast, most D lesions either showed an increase or mild decrease between baseline and follow-up. CONCLUSION: Na[18F]Fluoride uptake in visually classified r-axSpA and D lesions in r-axSpA patients on PET/CT demonstrated a striking different change in both the number of r-axSpA lesions and quantitative tracer uptake herein versus D lesions while on biological treatment.
candidates.title_ja: 放射線写真軸心脊椎関節炎患者の縦断データセットにおける、Na[18F]フッ化物PET/CTにおける軸方向脊椎関節炎関連病変と変性病変の鑑別。
candidates.abstract_ja: 目的:生物学的治療中に放射線写真軸向脊椎関節炎(r-axSpA)患者の軸骨におけるNa[18F]フッ素取り込みの縦方向変化を調査し、r-axSpAおよび変性(D)病変に焦点を当てた。方法:活動性r-axSpA患者20名を対象とした。Na[18F]フッ素陽電子放出断層撮影/コンピュータ断層撮影(PET/CT)スキャンを生物療法開始前および12週および52週に実施した。軸骨におけるPET陽性病変は、2人の盲検リーダーによってスコアリングおよび分類された。定量的なNa[18F]フッ素取り込みは、個別の統合全血活動濃度(SUVAUC)を補正した標準化取り込み値(SUV)の測定によって評価された。結果:視覚的にNa[18F]フッ化物取り込みを伴う病変は合計276件で検出され、そのうち98件(36%)がr-axSpA、46件(17%)がDと定義されました。r-axSpA病変の総数は、ベースラインの98件から12週目の67件(-32%)、52週の55件(-18%)に減少し、D病変の数は時間経過とともに安定していました。r-axSpA病変の大多数は胸椎(84%)で観察され、D病変の大多数は腰椎(48%)で観察されました。定量的には、r-axSpA病変の84%と88%が、それぞれベースラインと12週および52週の間にNa[18F]フッ素取り込みの減少を示しました。対照的に、ほとんどのD病変はベースラインと追跡観察の間に増加または軽度の減少を示しました。結論:Na[18F]PET/CT患者における視覚的に分類されたr-axSpAおよびD病変におけるフッ素取り込みは、生物学的治療中のD病変とD病変と区別され、r-axSpA病変の数および定量的トレーサー取り込みに著しい異なる変化が示されました。

candidates.title: Bead‐Based Enrichment Methods for Unbiased Secretome Profiling Enable Unprecedented Protein Coverage in an Immune Cell Model
candidates.abstract: Bead-based enrichment strategies for low-abundance proteins in biofluids, followed by LC-MS/MS analysis, have dramatically increased the coverage of the serum and plasma proteome. These technologies effectively mitigate the dynamic range limitations imposed by high-abundance proteins like albumin, thereby facilitating the detection of low-abundance proteins. Here, we demonstrate that bead-based enrichment strategies are also disrupting the field of secretomics by enabling easy access to thousands of proteins released into the cell-conditioned media, even in the presence of physiologically relevant growth supplements, such as fetal bovine serum. Using lipopolysaccharide-stimulated THP-1 human acute monocytic leukemia cells as a model of inflammatory activation, we demonstrate that two independent bead-based enrichment platforms, ENRICH-iST and Proteograph, enable comprehensive characterization of secreted proteins in the conditioned media. Application of these approaches provided novel insights into the regulation of cytokine and chemokine signaling pathways that remained inaccessible without enrichment, even when employing labor-intensive and time-consuming deep fractionation workflows. Taken together, these findings underscore the potential of bead-based enrichment methods to overcome long-standing limitations in secretome analysis, offering a scalable and efficient route to uncover complex signaling networks with direct relevance to both fundamental biology and translational research.
candidates.title_ja: バイアスのかからないセクレトームプロファイリングのためのビーズベース濃縮法により、免疫細胞モデルでこれまでにないタンパク質網羅性を実現
candidates.abstract_ja: 生体液中の低存在量タンパク質を対象としたビーズベースの濃縮戦略とそれに続くLC-MS/MS分析は、血清および血漿プロテオームのカバレッジを劇的に向上させた。これらの技術は、アルブミンのような高存在量タンパク質によって課されるダイナミックレンジの制限を効果的に緩和し、それによって低存在量タンパク質の検出を容易にする。本研究では、ビーズベースの濃縮戦略が、ウシ胎児血清などの生理学的に関連する成長サプリメントの存在下においても、細胞馴化培地に放出された数千のタンパク質への容易なアクセスを可能にすることで、セクレトミクスの分野をも変革しつつあることを実証する。炎症性活性化のモデルとしてリポ多糖刺激THP-1ヒト急性単球性白血病細胞を使用し、2つの独立したビーズベースの濃縮プラットフォームであるENRICH-iSTとProteographにより、馴化培地中の分泌タンパク質の包括的な特性解析が可能になることを示す。これらのアプローチの適用により、労力と時間がかかるディープ分画ワークフローを用いた場合でも、濃縮なしではアクセスできなかったサイトカインおよびケモカインシグナル伝達経路の調節に関する新たな知見が得られた。総合すると、これらの知見は、セクレトーム分析における長年の制限を克服する上でのビーズベースの濃縮法の潜在能力を強調するものであり、基礎生物学およびトランスレーショナルリサーチの両方に直接関連する複雑なシグナル伝達ネットワークを解明するための、スケーラブルかつ効率的な経路を提供するものである。

candidates.title: Summary of Research: Two-Stage Estimation of Overall Survival in the Phase 3 CheckMate 9ER Trial, Adjusting for the Impact of Subsequent Therapy.
candidates.abstract: This is a summary of a post hoc analysis of the phase 3 CheckMate 9ER study. CheckMate 9ER demonstrated a significant overall survival (OS) benefit for first-line cabozantinib plus nivolumab (CaboNivo) versus sunitinib (SUN) in patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma (aRCC). However, receiving subsequent therapy can distort true OS benefits. This analysis used two-stage estimation (TSE) to model a hypothetical scenario to assess the OS benefit of CaboNivo versus SUN, removing the effect of subsequent treatment. In stage 1, multivariate modeling estimated the extent to which subsequent therapy extended OS in patients who discontinued their original study treatment. In stage 2, an adjusted hazard ratio (HR) for OS assessed the relative impact of CaboNivo versus SUN without the effects of subsequent treatment. TSE-adjusted counterfactual median OS [95% confidence interval (CI)] was 42.7 (38.4-49.1) months for CaboNivo and 21.3 (18.1-24.9) months for SUN [HR 0.53 (95% CI 0.43-0.65; p < 0.001)]; unadjusted estimates were 46.5 (40.6-53.7) months for CaboNivo and 35.5 (29.2-42.8) months for SUN [HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.65-0.96; p = 0.0196)]. Removing the effect of subsequent therapy increased the estimated OS benefit of CaboNivo versus SUN, reinforcing CaboNivo as a first-line standard of care for aRCC.Trial Registration NCT03141177.
candidates.title_ja: 研究概要:第3相CheckMate 9ER試験における全生存の2段階推定(後続治療の影響調整)。
candidates.abstract_ja: これは第3相CheckMate 9ER試験の事後分析の要約です。CheckMate 9ERは、進行した腎細胞癌(aRCC)患者において、第一選択カボザンチニブとニボルマブ(CaboNivo)併用(CaboNivo)がスニチニブ(SUN)に対して有意な全体生存(OS)利益を示しました。しかし、その後の治療を受けることで真のOS効果が歪むことがあります。本解析では、2段階推定(TSE)を用いて、CaboNivoとSUNのOS効果を評価する仮説的なシナリオをモデル化し、その後の治療の影響を除外しました。第1段階では、多変量モデリングにより、元の治療を中止した患者における後続治療の延長度合いを推定しました。第2段階では、OSの調整済みハザード比(HR)を用いて、CaboNivoとSUNの相対的な影響を後続治療の影響なしに評価しました。TSE調整後の中央値OS(95%信頼区間)はカボニボが42.7ヶ月(38.4-49.1)、SUNが21.3ヶ月(18.1-24.9)であった[HR 0.53(95% CI 0.43-0.65;p < 0.001)]。未調整推定ではカボニボが46.5ヶ月(40.6-53.7)、SUNが35.5ヶ月(29.2-42.8)であった[HR 0.79(95% CI 0.65-0.96;p = 0.0196)]。後続治療の効果を除去することで、CaboNivoの推定OS利益がSUNより向上し、CaboNivoがaRCCの第一選択標準治療として強化された。試験登録NCT03141177。

candidates.title: Summary of Research: Health-Related Quality-of-Life Profile and Clinical Outcomes in First-Line Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Modeling Analysis Based on the CheckMate 9ER Study.
candidates.abstract: This is a summary of a post hoc analysis of the phase 3 CheckMate 9ER study. CheckMate 9ER demonstrated a significant improvement in progression-free survival and overall survival with first-line cabozantinib plus nivolumab (CaboNivo) versus sunitinib (SUN) in patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma. First-line CaboNivo also maintained or improved health-related quality of life (HRQoL) versus SUN. However, the relationship between clinical efficacy and patient treatment experience remains underexplored. This post hoc analysis investigated the relationship between changes in HRQoL and clinical outcomes, and used latent class analysis (LCA) to identify symptom-based profiles at week 13 predictive of disease course. Early worsening of bone pain [hazard ratio (HR) 1.45, p = 0.010] and sleep quality (HR 1.45, p = 0.007) were associated with increased risk of mortality. LCA identified three distinct patient profiles at week 13; those in the limited symptoms class were more likely to have received CaboNivo and to have a longer treatment duration, and were generally less likely to experience disease progression than patients in other symptom classes. This analysis demonstrated a link between early changes in patient-reported outcomes and efficacy in the CheckMate 9ER study, highlighting the importance of balancing efficacy, tolerability, and HRQoL to optimize treatment outcomes and support shared decision-making.Trial Registration NCT03141177.

candidates.abstract_ja: これは第3相CheckMate 9ER試験の事後分析の要約です。CheckMate 9ERは、進行した腎細胞癌患者において、カボザンチニブとニボルマブ(CaboNivo)を比較した第一選択のカボザンチニブ併用(CaboNivo)とスニチニブ(SUN)を比較し、進行性無進行生存期間および全生存期間が有意に改善したことを示しました。また、第一選択のCaboNivoはSUNに比べて健康関連生活の質(HRQoL)を維持または改善しました。しかし、臨床効果と患者の治療体験との関係は依然として十分に解明されていません。このポストホック分析ではHRQoLの変化と臨床アウトカムの関係を調査し、13週目の症状に基づく病変予測プロファイルを特定するために潜在クラス分析(LCA)を用いました。骨痛の早期悪化[ハザード比(HR)1.45、p = 0.010]および睡眠の質(HR 1.45、p = 0.007)は死亡リスクの増加と関連していました。LCAは13週目に3つの異なる患者プロファイルを特定しました。限定症状クラスの者はCaboNivoを受けており、治療期間が長く、他の症状クラスの患者よりも病気の進行を経験する可能性が一般的に低かったです。この分析は、CheckMate 9ER研究における患者報告アウトカムの早期変化と有効性との関連を示し、治療結果の最適化と意思決定の共有を支援するために有効性、忍容性、心拍品質のバランスの重要性を強調しました。試験登録NCT03141177。

candidates.title: EARTH-HCM: A Real-World Tool to Visualize the Burden of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy in the United States.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: There is limited evidence on geographical distribution of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) disease burden and a lack of visualization of national data for patient outcomes among patients with HCM. OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the feasibility of leveraging claims data to identify patients with HCM, estimate geographic disease burden, and integrate clinical and economic outcomes within a scalable visualization framework capable of supporting hypothesis generation and future outcomes research. METHODS: EARTH-HCM will be an open access, education tool to visualize patient characteristics, treatments, clinical outcomes, healthcare resource utilization, and costs for patients with HCM. This is a retrospective, observational study of longitudinal claims data from 2016 to 2023, with the first HCM diagnosis being considered the index date. RESULTS: Among 431,457 patients with a diagnosis for HCM, 166,081 (38.5%) patients had oHCM and 265,376 (61.5%) had nHCM. Among HCM patients, 51.1% were male with a mean age of 60.1 (17.7) years and median follow-up of 3.0 (2.4) years. Most patients were in age groups of 65+ (53.4%) and 55-64 (20.5%) and resided in the South (36.3%), followed by the Northeast (24.8%), Midwest (24.3%), and West (14.6%). CONCLUSIONS: EARTH-HCM demonstrates the feasibility of a national real-world surveillance framework to visualize the geographic distribution and healthcare burden of HCM and support future clinical and economic outcomes research.
candidates.title_ja: EARTH-HCM:米国における肥厚性心筋症の負担を可視化するための実例ツール。
candidates.abstract_ja: 背景:肥厚性心筋症(HCM)疾患負担の地理的分布に関する証拠は限られており、HCM患者の転帰に関する全国データの可視化が不足しています。目的:請求データを活用してHCM患者の特定、地理的疾患負担の推定、仮説生成および将来のアウトカム研究を支えるスケーラブルな可視化フレームワーク内で臨床および経済的アウトカムを統合する可能性を評価すること。方法:EARTH-HCMは、HCM患者の特徴、治療、臨床アウトカム、医療資源利用率、費用を可視化するためのオープンアクセスの教育ツールとなります。これは2016年から2023年までの縦断的請求データを遡及的かつ観察的に研究し、最初のHCM診断をインデックス日とみなします。結果:HCMと診断された431,457人の患者のうち、166,081人(38.5%)がoHCM、265,376人(61.5%)がnHCMでした。HCM患者のうち51.1%が男性で、平均年齢は60.1歳(17.7)歳、中央値追跡期間は3.0年(2.4)でした。患者の大半は65+歳(53.4%)および55-64歳(20.5%)の年齢層で、南部(36.3%)、次いで北東部(24.8%)、中西部(24.3%)、西部(14.6%)が続きました。結論:EARTH-HCMは、HCMの地理的分布と医療負担を可視化し、将来の臨床および経済的アウトカム研究を支援するための全国的な実世界監視フレームワークの実現可能性を示しています。

candidates.title: Sodium depletion is associated with the response to glepaglutide in short bowel syndrome with chronic intestinal failure
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Glepaglutide, a long-acting glucagon-like peptide 2 (GLP-2) analogue, reduces the need for parenteral support (PS) and increases nutrient absorption including sodium, in patients with short-bowel syndrome (SBS). We retrospectively studied the association between sodium homeostasis based on urine sodium levels and PS changes in response to glepaglutide for SBS chronic intestinal failure (SBS-CIF) patients. METHODS: The phase 3a EASE SBS-1 trial randomized 106 SBS patients with CIF (type III, according to the ESPEN classification) to receive glepaglutide 10 mg once (OW) or twice weekly (TW) vs. placebo for 24 weeks. We identified subgroups by sodium depletion, defined as a sodium concentration of <20 mmol/L or a sodium/potassium ratio of <1 in spot urine at baseline. Post-hoc subgroup analyses were performed using ANCOVA for the change in PS volume from baseline to week 24 (primary endpoint EASE SBS-1) and a logistic regression model for achieving the key secondary trial endpoint of clinical response (≥20 % reduction in PS volume from baseline to weeks 20 and 24). Groups receiving glepaglutide OW or TW were pooled in all analyses. We adjusted for sodium depletion, colon-in-continuity (CiC), treatment (active/placebo), and treatment-by-sodium depletion interaction. RESULTS: 42 % (22/52) of patients without CiC vs. 9 % (5/54) with CiC were sodium-depleted at baseline (p<0.0001). The overall prevalence of sodium depletion increased from baseline (25 %) to week 24 (36 %). Patients without sodium depletion (n = 79) had a significantly greater PS reduction with glepaglutide vs. placebo (p = 0.02). The nondepleted patients receiving glepaglutide were numerically more likely to achieve a clinical response in PS reduction (p = 0.12). Patients with sodium depletion at baseline had nonsignificant differences in PS reduction or clinical response (n = 27) and were likely to remain depleted at week 24 (n = 24, OR 13.5; p<0.0001). CONCLUSION: Sodium depletion is more common in SBS-CIF without CiC. This post-hoc analysis suggests that glepaglutide is more effective at reducing PS volume if sodium homeostasis is achieved before GLP-2 treatment begins.

candidates.title: A039 Biological significance of small extracellular vesicle remodeling in Huntington’s disease
candidates.abstract: In neurodegenerative diseases, extracellular vesicles (EVs) are often viewed as vehicles of toxic cargo that may promote pathobiology. However, a major function of EVs such as small EVs (SEVs) is to provide a platform for signalling between cells, and whether SEVs may be relevant to the regulation of intercellular communication between brain cells, such as neural cells and mature neurons, in the context of neurodegenerative diseases has remained largely unknown. To characterise the biological and molecular features of SEVs in the context of neurodegenerative diseases, such as Huntington’s disease (HD), we use models such as on-chip cortico-striatal connections derived from HD knock-in mice and human HD iPS cell-derived neural stem cells (NSCs) and neurons. Our results show how NSCs and neurons may remodel the release, function and protein composition of SEVs in response to HD. We will present the fundamental and translational implications of our findings. Funding ANR, France; Huntington’s Disease Foundation, USA; CHDI Foundation, USA

candidates.title: D021 Stage-dependent variability of endogenous fluid biomarkers and clinical measurements across HD-ISS stages in Huntington’s disease
candidates.abstract: Therapeutic trials in Huntington’s disease (HD) are increasingly reliant on fluid biomarker assays for accurate quantification of endogenous protein analytes used for target engagement, disease progression, and safety profiling. In particular, measurement of neurofilament light chain (NfL) and mutant huntingtin (mHTT) in HDClarity provides an opportunity to evaluate analytical rigor and biological reproducibility across matched CSF, plasma, and serum specimens within a deeply phenotyped cohort. Here, we investigated the performance of ultra-sensitive immunoassays for NfL, mHTT, and polyQ-independent HTT across these matrixes in a pre-selected cohort of 80 individuals with paired visits, in which healthy controls and people with HD were sampled 4–8 weeks apart. This narrow temporal window reduced the likelihood of clinical disease progression. Results showed high between-visit reproducibility for NfL and mHTT, whereas only NfL demonstrated strong concordance between CSF and blood; HTT analytes correlated poorly across matrices. Using imputed HD-ISS stages, we found that both NfL and mHTT increased in a stage-dependent manner, with NfL showing steepest rise in earlier stages. At the population level, both biomarkers showed associations with clinical measures including TMS, SDMT, and TFC, but individual values showed marked heterogeneity. The greatest spread was observed within HD-ISS stage 3. Within this stage, NfL aligned with disease burden measures including CAP and cUHDRS, whereas mHTT did not correlate with CAP score. These findings suggest that NfL may be the more reliable readout of HD disease burden and may help refine progression prediction within HD-ISS stage 3 when interpreted alongside TFC, cUHDRS, and CAP.

candidates.title: Safety of Nonsteroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drug Use in Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: Use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) after a traumatic brain injury (TBI) is controversial due to potential worsening of an intracranial hemorrhage (ICH). This study evaluated if NSAID use within 14 days of TBI was associated with a clinically significant progression of intracranial bleed (PIB). METHODS: A retrospective, propensity score-weighted study was conducted in adult patients with a TBI admitted to an American College of Surgeons Certified Level I Trauma Center. The NSAID group included patients who received at least one dose of an NSAID within 14 days of injury while admitted. The control group included patients who did not receive NSAIDs. The primary end point was incidence of a clinically significant PIB (decrease in the Glasgow Coma Score (GCS) > 2 and an increased or new ICH). Secondary outcomes included need for additional neurosurgical intervention and PIB on imaging regardless of GCS change. RESULTS: 978 patients were included: 284 in the NSAID group and 694 in the control group. Most patients had an Abbreviated Injury Score head > 2 (88%) and a subdural hematoma (57%). Fifty-two percent of patients had a mixed bleed. A clinically significant PIB occurred in 0.35% in the NSAID group and 1.2% in the control group (Hazards Ratio 0.1, 95% Confidence Interval 0.01-0.82, p = 0.032). There was no difference in additional neurosurgical operations or PIB regardless of GCS change. In the NSAID group, there was no significant difference in time from admission to NSAID administration between patients who experienced a PIB and those who did not have a PIB (1.9 days vs. 4.7 days, respectively, p = 0.06). CONCLUSION: In this single-center, retrospective, propensity score-weighted study, NSAIDs were not associated with an increased risk of clinically significant PIB in patients with acute TBI when administered within 14 days of injury. NSAIDs appear safe in the acute phase post-TBI. Prospective studies are needed to validate our results.

candidates.title: Nonpathogenic SIV Infection in Sooty Mangabeys Is Characterized by a Lack of Activation and Expansion of Monocytes.
candidates.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Natural hosts of simian immunodeficiency virus (SIV), including sooty mangabeys (SMs), maintain high viremia without progressing to AIDS and AIDS-associated histopathogenesis. The mechanisms underlying this protection and lack of pathogenesis remain incompletely understood, particularly in relation to monocyte/macrophage activation. METHODS: Plasma soluble CD163 (sCD163), monocyte CD163 expression, and monocyte subset phenotypes were quantified in uninfected and naturally SIV-infected SMs and compared with uninfected and SIV-infected rhesus macaques (RMs). Flow cytometry and multivariate analyses were used to assess monocyte activation and subset distribution. RESULTS: sCD163 levels and CD163 surface expression were increased in SIV-infected RMs but not SMs. SIV-infected SMs exhibited reduced CD14+CD16+ monocyte expansion and lower expression of CD64, MAC387, CD11b, and CCR2 compared with SIV-infected RMs. Machine learning identified CD14+CD16+CCR8+ monocytes as the top discriminator of SIV infection in SMs. CONCLUSION: These findings indicate a lack of monocyte activation in SMs that correlates with non-pathogenic infection.

candidates.title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of RIPK1 inhibitor, SAR443820, in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (HIMALAYA): a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial.
candidates.abstract: BACKGROUND: RIPK1, a protein regulating inflammatory signalling and cell death, is implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathophysiology. SAR443820 is a selective, oral, CNS-penetrant, reversible RIPK1 inhibitor. We aimed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and efficacy of SAR443820 in participants with ALS. METHODS: This multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial was conducted at 63 clinical sites in 13 countries (Belgium, Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Sweden, the UK, and the USA). Adults (aged 18-80 years) with a diagnosis of possible ALS, clinically probable ALS, clinically probable laboratory-supported ALS, or clinically definite ALS, in accordance with the revised El Escorial World Federation of Neurology criteria, were randomly assigned (2:1) by use of a stratified block design (blocks of three) to receive either 20 mg SAR443820 orally twice per day or matching placebo in the 24-week double-blind period. Randomisation was done centrally using interactive response technology and stratified by geographical region of trial site, region of ALS onset, use of riluzole, use of edaravone, and use of the combination of sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol. Participants, care providers, investigators, and outcomes assessors were masked to trial intervention. The primary outcome was a change in ALS Functional Rating Scale Revised (ALSFRS-R) total score from baseline to week 24 and was calculated for all participants who had an ALSFRS-R total score available at baseline and at week 24. Safety analyses included all randomly assigned participants receiving one dose or more of trial intervention. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05237284) and was terminated early. FINDINGS: Between April 13, 2022, and July 17, 2023, 397 participants were screened and 305 randomly assigned to SAR443820 (n=203) or placebo (n=102); six were excluded from the primary analysis due to missing baseline ALSFRS-R values. Mean age was 56·9 years (SD 11·5); 183 (60%) participants were male and 122 (40%) were female. Least squares mean change in ALSFRS-R from baseline to week 24 was -6·73 (95% CI -7·48 to -5·98) for SAR443820 group (n=169) and -6·32 (-7·36 to -5·27) for placebo group (n=87). There was no statistically significant difference between the study groups (least squares mean difference -0·41 [95% CI -1·71 to 0·88]). Participants in the SAR443820 group had higher incidence of adverse events (171 [85%] of 202 vs placebo 80 [78%] of 102) and treatment discontinuations (28 [14%] of 202 vs placebo five [5%] of 102), with elevated hepatic enzymes being the most common cause. Nine deaths occurred in the double-blind period (seven [3%] of 202 in the SAR443820 group and two [2%] of 102 in the placebo group); none was attributed to SAR443820. INTERPRETATION: SAR443820 did not show clinical benefit and was associated with higher hepatic enzyme increase, indicating that further clinical development of SAR443820 in ALS is not warranted. FUNDING: Sanofi.

candidates.title: UK Dementia Trials Network: an expert-informed framework for improving representation in dementia trials.
candidates.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia worldwide, yet clinical trials remain unrepresentative of those most affected. Ethnic minoritized groups, socioeconomically deprived communities, adults over 75, and populations in low- and middle-income countries are consistently underrepresented, limiting generalizability and reinforcing health inequities. This white paper draws on an international roundtable on Diversity and Inclusion in Dementia Trials, convened by the UK Dementia Trials Network at the Alzheimer's Association International Conference 2025. We determined that key barriers to research participation included geographic distance, financial burden, restrictive eligibility criteria, invasive procedures, and limited study partner support. We also highlight gaps in ethnic diversity and the inadequate integration of sex and gender considerations in trial design and reporting. Improving representation in AD trials is both a scientific and moral imperative. Achieving this requires coordinated action across community engagement and trust building, data transparency and reporting, global trial access and capacity building, eligibility criteria reform, and financial and logistical support for participants. We propose an expert-informed implementation framework derived from the roundtable that identifies actionable strategies, responsible stakeholders, measurable indicators, and expected implementation outcomes to support translation of our recommendations into practice.

candidates.title: Comprehensive Clinical Evaluation Demonstrates Favorable Safety, Robust Neutralizing Antibody Responses, and Broad Population Immunogenicity to a Chikungunya Virus Virus-like Particle Vaccine (VIMKUNYA)
candidates.abstract: Abstract The chikungunya virus (CHIKV) virus-like particle (VLP) vaccine, VIMKUNYA ™ , has demonstrated favorable safety and immunogenicity throughout its clinical development program. Here, we present aggregated safety outcomes from 5 phase 2/3 trials and immunogenicity outcomes from 4 trials conducted at multiple US sites in healthy participants aged 12 to 95 years. Participants received a single intramuscular 40 µg dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine or placebo. Immunogenicity was assessed using serum neutralizing antibody (SNA) titers (NT 80 ), geometric mean titers (GMTs), and seroresponse rates at predefined timepoints. Preclinical nonhuman primate (NHP) data indicated that the regulatory clinical seroresponse threshold (NT 80 ≥100) is more conservative, approximately 4-fold higher than titers associated with sterilizing immunity, prompting exploratory analyses at additional thresholds: NT 80 ≥25.7 (associated with sterilizing immunity in NHPs) and NT 80 ≥15 (assay lower level of quantitation). This exploration of other relevant thresholds may provide valuable context for healthcare professionals and policy makers when evaluating immunization strategies. The CHIKV VLP vaccine elicited rapid and robust neutralizing antibody responses: 47% of recipients achieved NT 80 ≥100 at 7 days postvaccination (Day 8), rising to 96% at 2 weeks and 97% by 3 weeks postvaccination, with 85% maintaining seroresponse at 6 months (Day 183). At Day 8, 92% of participants achieved the NT 80 ≥15 assay threshold and 86% achieved the NHP NT 80 ≥25.7 biological threshold; at Day 183 these responses were maintained by 99% and 98%, respectively. Younger participants and females exhibited more rapid early responses and more sustained seroresponse at later timepoints, reflecting age- and sex- associated immunologic gradients. The vaccine was well-tolerated; most adverse events were mild or moderate, predominantly injection site pain, headache, fatigue, and myalgia. No vaccine-related safety signals or cases of CHIKV-like illness were identified. Older adults reported fewer solicited and unsolicited adverse events than younger age groups, and no treatment‑related serious adverse events observed, supporting a favorable safety profile across all age groups. Together, these findings demonstrate that a single dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine induces rapid, high-magnitude, and durable neutralizing immunity with a favorable safety profile, supporting its use in individuals aged ≥ 12 years and its suitability for broad public health implementation.

candidates.title: Holonic Bioprocess Units as Autonomous Cyber-Physical Modules for Distributed Biopharmaceutical Automation
candidates.abstract: Modular biomanufacturing requires process units that can be integrated and reconfigured without losing process constraints, quality boundaries, or traceability. ISA-95, ISA-88, and Module Type Package (MTP) provide established integration structures, while autonomous bioreactor initiatives demonstrate the value of process analytical technology (PAT), real-time analytics, and feedback control for individual unit operations. However, these approaches do not define how modular units can interpret process intent, assess their own capabilities, and adapt under explicit policies. This work-in-progress paper proposes artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled Holonic Bioprocess Units (HBPUs) that couple a physical bioprocess unit and deterministic control with an Asset Administration Shell (AAS) Type 3-inspired active digital twin acting as the HBPU agent. The active digital twin represents state, capabilities, constraints, data quality, and evidence requirements and uses this knowledge for intent interpretation, capability matching, and policy-constrained interaction. System-level orchestration and governance remain with agents that do not necessarily represent physical assets.

candidates.title: Image Analysis Tools for Continuous Label-free Quantification of Proliferation and Adipogenic Differentiation of Mesenchymal Stem Cells
candidates.abstract: Abstract Background Accurate quantification of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and adipogenic differentiation is essential for applications ranging from metabolic disease research to cultivated fat production. However, conventional endpoint assays fail to capture the dynamics of these processes. Label-free live-cell imaging, combined with automated image analysis, enables continuous, non-invasive quantification over time. Methods Here, we present a comparative analysis of a device-integrated live-cell imaging analysis pipeline and custom-trained Cellpose segmentation models for label-free quantification of proliferation and adipogenic differentiation in human and porcine mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). Results Both approaches enabled robust determination of cell number and confluence during proliferation. The device-integrated analysis showed higher accuracy at high confluence, whereas the custom-trained model achieved reliable single-cell segmentation at low to intermediate densities. During adipogenic differentiation, both methods successfully quantified adipocytes but differed in their segmentation strategies. The device-integrated analysis primarily detected contrast-rich regions associated with mature adipocytes, while the model segmented individual adipocytes, enabling quantification of both adipocyte area and number and allowing earlier detection of differentiation events. Custom-trained models demonstrated adaptability across species and imaging modalities, including manually acquired brightfield images. Conclusions Overall, label-free image analysis reduces experimental effort, avoids staining-related artefacts, and enables time-resolved characterization of cellular processes. While device-integrated analysis offers ease of use and seamless integration, Cellpose models provide superior flexibility and applicability, highlighting their complementary strengths for advanced cell culture analysis. All developed Cellpose models are publicly available.

candidates.title: Super-Res Tanager: A Deep Learning Based Sharpening Approach For Tanager Hyperspectral Images
candidates.abstract: Spaceborne hyperspectral imaging has evolved in the past 25 years, moving from research missions to the first commercial platforms. In August 2024, Tanager-1 was launched as the first in a constellation of satellites developed by Planet and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory through the Carbon Mapper Coalition. Spaceborne hyperspectral systems allow repeated, precise mapping of atmospheric properties and surface characteristics at large-scale. However, in order to manage data volume, they often have a coarser spatial resolution compared to the high spectral resolution they achieve. Combining these sensors with higher spatial resolution monitoring systems through image fusion or pansharpening increases the value of these sensors for use cases where spatial detail matters. Under the Horizon Europe project MINEYE we are exploring the combination of Tanager and PlanetScope for mineral applications. We introduce a novel deep learning pipeline, which fuses 30 m Planet Tanager hyperspectral (HS) data with 10 m PlanetScope multispectral (MS) imagery. Our solution is the first specifically designed for this sensor pair and employs a two-stage approach: first, a robust multi-scale co-registration aligns the sensors, followed by a specialized dual-branch U-Net for 3x spatial enhancement. Critically, we move beyond synthetic data by training and validating the model on a large-scale, real-world dataset of 44 global Areas of Interest (AOIs) using Wald’s protocol. Validation results demonstrate high fidelity, achieving a Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) of 1.99.

candidates.title: The first report of Si Bridge type 2.5D package's reliability for Automotive Applications
candidates.abstract: Demand for artificial intelligence (AI) in automotive application is growing. This leads to chiplet devices, and 2.5D/3.5D packages should be mandatory in automotive systems in the near future. AI would be used mainly in Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS). Required reliability level of AECQ100 and AECQ104 is Grade 2. On the other hand, 2.5D and 3.5D packages’ structure has many layers of different materials which causes critical reliability risks. It is urgent to clarify the reliability potential of advanced packages in automotive applications. ASRA (Advanced SoC Research for Automotive) developed a mechanical test vehicle (MTV) of a Si bridge type 2.5D package to find out reliability risks in automotive use and its improvement plan. In this paper, we introduce our achievements in 3 parts, which are "Design concept", "Stiffener design DOE" and "Reliability results". In the 1st part, the design of Test Vehicle (TV) is introduced. The MTV mimics the structure of a chiplet that consists of two logic dies and two accelerator dies. The details of the 60mm x 60mm TV are given. In the 2nd part, stiffener Design Of Experiments (DOE) are investigated. Stiffener’s foot width, thickness and material are parameters of DOE. A thinner Cu stiffener does not have enough performance to control warpage. SUS stiffener has the smallest warpage variation during temperature change. In the 3rd part, the results of reliability tests are introduced. To optimize the material, we conducted preevaluation of two types of chip-on-wafer underfill resins. Temperature Cycle Test (TCT) based on AECQ100 and AECQ104 is carried out. The results are discussed with measured package warpage data.
